recorded_child_runs: actual_processes/*/receipt.json and reproduced wrappers' own PROCESS_RECEIPTS.json; actual PID, argv, cwd, UTC start/end, observed exit, raw streams and hashes retained
foundational_read_and_setup_calls: Initial shell reads, evidence-directory creation and initial authentication ran before the independent recorder existed. exec_command exposed actual exit and elapsed time but did not expose their shell PID or separated raw stdout/stderr. No shell PID, start/end time or missing raw separation is fabricated. Initial authentication carries its own UTC and result; commands/results remain in conversation tool history.
other_read_only_shell_calls: Cat/sed/rg and inventory read calls are recorded in conversation tool history; they are source-inspection calls, not theorem diagnostics or synthetic children. Tool-level output truncation occurred for some batched reads; relevant unique source sections were separately read, and comprehensive hashes/structured audit data reside in the review folder.
historical_process_limit: Prior historical receipts are cross-bound to preserved source and raw output hashes; the old kernel process state is not newly observable. Reproduced current executions have fresh actual child receipts.
retained_failure_limits: Preparer patch/JavaScript parse rejections and index-glob JSONDecodeError, plus round-one ENOSPC and lossless own-copy compaction records, remain preserved and are not overwritten or recast as successful runs.
final_closure: Closure must not add a post-manifest own receipt. Its manifest records actual creator PID/argv/start UTC and the tool result exposes observed completion/exit and printed end UTC. ROOT may authenticate externally; this reviewer does not write ROOT's service or authentication directory.
security_scope: Sequential bounded local disposable-output contract; arbitrary concurrent hostile filesystem replacement not claimed or tested
